ReviewedInteractions.Rationale: Six hash-bound call-site adapters consume the result of the Script Extender-owned function at RVA 0x196870; nonzero Vanilla or extender results remain authoritative.
The inline site at RVA 0x704CC remains inside the original trampoline path of the extender detour at RVA 0x6FE90; an explicit SkipOriginalFunction remains authoritative.
RVA 0x11E150 is invoked as a delegate and is not detoured or patched by the mod.
References to RVAs 0x196280, 0x192750 and 0x199110 are validated calls or enclosing function bounds, not competing function-entry detours.
No release mod detours or patches the new extender target at RVA 0xDCD60 or its sole caller at RVA 0x1855A0.
